IRIS-PREDICTOR.thesis: IRIS-PREDICTOR implements an end-to-end MLOps pipeline that trains a RandomForest classifier and serves it through a Flask API.
IRIS-PREDICTOR.description: The repository contains Python scripts for model training (train_model.py, model.py) and a Flask app (app.py) with a static HTML front-end, a Dockerfile for containerisation, and a render.yaml for deployment to Render. CI is configured via GitHub Actions, runs on each push, and builds and pushes the container to GHCR. Dependencies are listed in requirements.txt and ignored files are specified in .dockerignore.

MOVIE_RECOMMENDER.thesis: It provides an item-based collaborative filtering recommender for MovieLens 100k, exposed through a FastAPI service.
MOVIE_RECOMMENDER.description: The repository includes a FastAPI application (app/main.py) with a model (app/model.py), a training script (app/train.py), and an HTML front-end (app/templates/index.html). It is containerised using a Dockerfile and .dockerignore, with dependencies listed in requirements.txt, and is built with Python and HTML.

PatelHem.thesis: PatelHem is a self-classifying engineering portfolio that reads repositories, scores them on five fixed axes, and publishes a self-updating catalogue.
PatelHem.description: The repository includes a TypeScript engine (src files such as adapter.ts, axes.ts, classify.ts, cli.ts, explain.ts, score.ts, signals.ts) with a test suite (15 test files) and package configuration. It also contains GitHub Actions workflows for CI, deployment files, and supporting documentation. The project is built with Node/TypeScript and deployed via Vercel.

linkedin_agent.thesis: A Python web application that automates posting and managing LinkedIn content.
linkedin_agent.description: The repository contains a Python backend with modules for LinkedIn integration, publishing, scheduling, and user management, plus HTML/CSS front-end assets. Database schema changes are handled with Alembic migration scripts. The project includes tests, linting configuration, and environment setup files.

vakil: Most merchants lose chargebacks by default rather than by argument — nobody assembled the evidence pack before the window closed. That gap is the product.

webathon.thesis: webathon is an HTML repository that provides a single web page design.
webathon.description: The repository includes a README and a 'design 1' folder containing an index.html file. It is built solely with HTML, totals 9 KB, and has five commits.
